Mixed purées

Tomato vegetable pasta

Paradicsomos zöldséges tészta

6 months+ Adjusted 30 min 4 portions

Mash the pasta so nothing firm is left. Serve from six months. This contains gluten.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 40 g small soup pasta (dry weight; wheat, so gluten)
  • 200 g ripe tomatoes (fresh, peeled, not a salted sauce)
  • 80 g carrot (peeled weight)
  • 80 g zucchini (peeled)

Allergens

gluten

Method

  1. Peel the carrot, zucchini, and tomatoes and chop them small.
  2. Cook the vegetables in a splash of unsalted water until very soft, then mash them.
  3. Boil the pasta in unsalted water well past the usual timing, until it is very soft.
  4. Drain the pasta and mash it into the sauce so no firm piece remains.
  5. Do not add salt, and do not wait for an older month to serve it.

Adjusted

Pasta that is still firm is too hard at 6 months. An older month is sometimes printed on this dish for no good reason.

Cook small pasta until very soft and mash it into a no-salt tomato, carrot, and zucchini sauce. Do not wait for a later month, since the pasta is only a gluten food served very soft.
